review.scope: fifteen original right-facing Reed windmill-dunk poses, character identity, human anatomy, hand-circle action, transparency, source isolation and atlas review
review.notes: The accepted cleanup preserves all fifteen distinct human Reed poses in strict row-major order and reduces the bright exterior red fringe while keeping the dark outline, face, braids, purple/gold kit, white lower-leg wear and purple/gold shoes. The sequence makes one right-arm windmill path behind the shoulder, down past the hip, forward low, up past the shoulder and overhead, with a two-foot landing and no drawn ball or props. The separate right-hand ball remains close to the moving hand in native standard and zoom120 gameplay captures; it stays carried through tick20 and releases at tick21. All fifteen atlas poses select as production art in both facings. The J.01 canon review permits mirroring Reed's body and uniform. The atlas is 512x384, SHA-256 9c062828bc9a7ea25fe14d412b5c574a712de9c4d9b94e7d4cc4a1bcf00aed28.
